ballots.rationale_text: Actually, while everyone fixates on p-2's presence in Storage, p-9's sudden flight to Reactor at tick 11 is the true tell of guilt.
I'm just so nervous because p-5 pointed out p-9 bolted to Reactor right when the body was found, which feels like a classic guilt trip to get away from the scene, doesn't it?
And then, the narrative settles on p-2, who slipped into Storage alone with the victim, a silence too heavy to ignore.
p-7 found the body I killed and pinned me, so I vote them out to silence the witness.
How do you know p-2 didn't kill p-3 in Storage? They were alone with the victim for four ticks, and that's the only solid lead I have.
I found p-8's body in East Hall, but p-5's movement there was visible and consistent, so I cannot be certain they are the killer.
A fox doesn't slip into the henhouse alone unless he's got eggs on his mind; I watched p-2 head to Storage right when p-3 did.
